name: REST API Design and Development
certifications: No vendor certification; assessed by API design reviews and a capstone
API Academy or Postman API Fundamentals Student Expert as companion badges

beginner.summary: For developers who build or consume web APIs. Covers HTTP for API design, resources and URIs, JSON bodies, status codes and problem details, filtering, sorting and field selection, pagination, OpenAPI descriptions, mock servers, implementing a designed API in any framework, API keys and OAuth 2.0 at a glance, HTTP caching, idempotency, versioning, documentation, API testing, validation, nested resources and rate limits.
prerequisites: Has written code in one back-end language
Knows what HTTP and JSON are
Has called an API from a tool or app
outcomes: Design clean, consistent REST APIs from requirements
Describe APIs with OpenAPI and mock them
Handle errors, pagination, caching, idempotency and versioning correctly
Build and test a designed API in a chosen framework

days.topic: REST API Design Overview and Tooling Setup
subtopics: REST compared with RPC, GraphQL and events
Who API consumers are and what they need
Installing an OpenAPI editor and linter
An HTTP client: Postman, Bruno or HTTPie
The course project: a library lending API
days.lab_task: Explore two well-known public APIs, note what makes them easy or hard to use, set up the design toolchain and sketch the resources for the library lending API.
days.deliverable: API review notes and first resource sketch
checks: Five strengths and five weaknesses noted across two APIs
Editor, linter, mock server and HTTP client all working
Main resources and relationships listed for the project

days.topic: HTTP Essentials for API Designers: Methods, Status Codes and Headers
subtopics: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE
HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 in brief
days.lab_task: Capture and explain the HTTP traffic of a public API, classify methods as safe or idempotent, and pick the right method and status code for twelve library operations.
days.deliverable: Method and status code table for the project
checks: Safe and idempotent methods classified correctly
Status code chosen and justified for each operation
Headers explained for three captured requests

days.topic: Resources, URIs and Naming
subtopics: Path segments compared with query parameters
Actions that do not fit CRUD
days.lab_task: Design URIs for books, members, loans and reservations, model the return-book action without verbs in the path where possible, and write a naming style guide.
days.deliverable: URI design and naming style guide
checks: Return-book action modelled as a resource or justified sub-resource
Style guide covers casing, plurals and identifiers

days.topic: Request and Response Bodies in JSON
subtopics: Dates, times and time zones in JSON
Nulls, empty values and missing fields
Envelopes and when to avoid them
days.lab_task: Design request and response bodies for every library resource with consistent naming, ISO 8601 dates, safe money values, enums and clear rules for nulls and missing fields.
checks: Example bodies validate against the schemas
Dates in ISO 8601 with offsets and money without floats
Null and missing field rules written and applied

days.topic: Status Codes and Error Responses with Problem Details
subtopics: Server errors and what to expose
Error codes for machines and messages for people
days.lab_task: Define a Problem Details error format with stable error codes and field errors, map every failure in the library API to a status code and document the error catalogue.
checks: Each failure has one status code and error code
Validation errors list each invalid field
Server errors expose a correlation ID and no stack traces

days.topic: Query Parameters: Filtering, Sorting and Field Selection
days.lab_task: Design filtering by author, genre and availability, sorting by title and date, field selection and free-text search for the books collection, with limits and defaults.
checks: Combined filters return the expected mock results
Unknown sort fields and oversized limits rejected
Every parameter documented with type and default

days.topic: Pagination Patterns
subtopics: Links to next and previous pages
days.lab_task: Design offset and cursor pagination for the books and loans collections, return navigation links, decide on total counts and show what happens to each pattern when data changes.
checks: No duplicates or gaps when items are added during paging
Responses include next and previous links
Pattern chosen per collection with reasons

days.topic: Writing an OpenAPI Description
days.lab_task: Write a complete OpenAPI 3.1 description for the library API with reusable components, examples, tags, security schemes and error responses, and fix every Spectral warning.
checks: Spectral reports no errors or warnings
Shared schemas defined once and referenced
Every operation has request and response examples

days.topic: Mocking APIs from OpenAPI
subtopics: Keeping mocks and implementations in step
days.lab_task: Run a mock server from the description, let a front-end classmate build two screens against it, collect feedback and change the design before any implementation.
days.deliverable: Mock server and design change log
checks: Mock returns examples for every operation
Mock rejects requests that break the description
Design changed from consumer feedback with reasons

days.topic: Implementing a Designed API in Your Framework
subtopics: Generating server stubs or writing code to the design
Spring Boot, ASP.NET Core, FastAPI, Express or Django REST Framework
Pagination and filtering in the database
Keeping code and description in step
Testing the implementation against the description
Reviewing the implementation for design drift
days.lab_task: Implement the library API in your chosen framework to match the description exactly, validate requests, return Problem Details and run Schemathesis against the running API.
days.deliverable: Working API that matches its description
checks: No responses that break the description
Invalid requests rejected with Problem Details
Implementation and description match after review

days.topic: Authentication for APIs: API Keys, Tokens and OAuth 2.0 at a Glance
days.lab_task: Add API keys for a partner endpoint and OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens with scopes for member endpoints, describe both in OpenAPI and test 401 and 403 cases.
checks: Security schemes and scopes shown in the docs
objectives: Secure APIs with keys and tokens

days.topic: Caching with HTTP Headers and ETags
subtopics: Caching for public and private data
days.lab_task: Add Cache-Control and ETags to book and author endpoints, support conditional GET, keep member data private and measure bandwidth saved through a reverse proxy cache.
checks: Bandwidth saved through the proxy measured

days.topic: Idempotency and Safe Retries
subtopics: Returning the original response on a retry
Concurrent requests with the same key
days.lab_task: Add idempotency keys to loan creation, return the original response on retries, handle two concurrent requests with the same key and document the behaviour.
checks: Retried request returns the same loan without duplicates
Only one loan created for the same key
Idempotency rules explained in the docs

days.topic: Versioning Strategies
days.lab_task: Classify ten proposed changes as compatible or breaking, ship one breaking change as a new version with deprecation and sunset headers, and detect breaking changes with oasdiff.
checks: Old version returns deprecation and sunset headers

days.topic: Documenting APIs for Developers
days.lab_task: Publish reference docs from the description, write a getting started guide and an authentication guide with examples in two languages, and test them with a new user.
checks: New user makes a first successful call in 15 minutes
Changes listed by date and impact

days.topic: Testing APIs with Postman or Bruno
subtopics: Running collections from the command line
days.lab_task: Build a collection that tests every library operation including errors and edge cases, chain requests for a loan flow, run it with data files and in CI.
checks: All tests pass against the API
Collection runs on every pull request

days.topic: Validation and Input Constraints
subtopics: Format validation for emails, dates and IDs
Size limits on bodies and arrays
Keeping validation in the description and code aligned
days.lab_task: Add constraints to every schema, choose a policy for unknown fields, enforce body and array size limits, add a cross-field rule and test validation with fuzzing.

days.topic: Designing Relationships and Nested Resources
subtopics: Nested URIs and how deep to go
days.lab_task: Design relationships between books, authors, members and loans with links, one level of nesting, an expand parameter and rules for deleting members with active loans.
checks: No URI deeper than one sub-resource level
Deleting a member with loans returns 409
objectives: Choose between links, nesting and embedding

days.topic: Rate Limits and Quotas from the Client's View
subtopics: Limits per key, user and IP
days.lab_task: Add per-key rate limits with standard headers and Retry-After, document them, write a client that backs off correctly and load test the behaviour.
days.deliverable: Rate limit design and well-behaved client
checks: Remaining quota shown in response headers
Client waits and succeeds after the limit resets

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Designing and Building a Library API
days.lab_task: Design the library lending API in OpenAPI, mock it and get consumer feedback, implement it with errors, pagination, caching, idempotency, security and limits, test it and present the design.
days.deliverable: OpenAPI description, implementation, tests and presentation
checks: Schemathesis finds no mismatches with the description
Design choices explained against REST principles
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one API
Design and build a complete REST API

intermediate.summary: For developers and leads who design APIs for other teams or partners. Covers the API-first workflow, style guides and Spectral rules, advanced OpenAPI, long-running and asynchronous operations, bulk operations, concurrency control, hypermedia, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect design, the OWASP API Security Top 10, webhooks, search APIs, evolution without breaking clients, contract testing, SDK generation, AsyncAPI, gateways and management, API observability, performance and internationalisation.
prerequisites: Has designed and built REST APIs with OpenAPI
Comfortable with HTTP caching, pagination and versioning
Works with at least one back-end framework
outcomes: Run an API-first process with style guides and automated checks
Design advanced API features: async operations, webhooks, bulk and search
Secure, observe and evolve APIs without breaking clients
Deliver APIs with SDKs, gateways and developer portals

days.topic: API-First Development Workflow
subtopics: Keeping the description as the source of truth
days.lab_task: Run an API-first cycle for a new orders API: gather use cases, design, review, mock for a front-end team, implement in parallel and gate merges on contract checks.
days.deliverable: API-first process record for one API
checks: Design review completed before implementation started
Front-end built against the mock while the API was implemented
Contract check blocks a mismatching implementation

days.topic: API Style Guides and Linting with Spectral
subtopics: Writing rules for naming, errors and pagination
Running rules in editors and CI
days.lab_task: Turn the team's API style guide into a Spectral ruleset with custom functions, run it in the editor and CI on three APIs and process one exception request.
checks: Ruleset catches naming, error and pagination violations
Violations found and fixed in each API
Exception recorded with reason and expiry

days.topic: Advanced OpenAPI: Components, Polymorphism and Webhooks
subtopics: Nullable and optional fields in OpenAPI 3.1
days.lab_task: Split a large description into files, model payment methods with a discriminator, describe webhooks, apply an overlay for a partner variant and bundle it for tools.
checks: Each payment type validated by the discriminator
Bundled file works in two tools

days.topic: Long-Running Operations and Asynchronous APIs
subtopics: When operations take too long for one request
days.lab_task: Design and build a report export as a long-running operation with 202 responses, a status resource, polling hints, cancellation, completion webhooks and expiring results.
checks: 202 returned with a status resource location
Operation moves to cancelled and stops work
Webhook delivered when the export finishes

days.topic: Bulk and Batch Operations
subtopics: Batch endpoints compared with many requests
days.lab_task: Add a bulk import endpoint for books that reports per-item results, supports partial success, enforces size limits, is idempotent and switches to async processing for large batches.
checks: Good rows saved and bad rows reported per item
Oversized batch rejected or moved to async

days.topic: Concurrency Control with ETags and Conditional Requests
subtopics: PATCH formats: JSON Merge Patch and JSON Patch
days.lab_task: Protect book updates with ETags and If-Match, require preconditions on updates, support JSON Merge Patch and show two clients resolving a conflict.
checks: Merge patch changes only the sent fields

days.topic: Hypermedia and HATEOAS in Practice
subtopics: Formats such as HAL and JSON:API
days.lab_task: Add links to loan responses that change with loan state, build a small client that follows links instead of building URLs and decide where hypermedia helps the project.
days.deliverable: Hypermedia responses and a decision note
checks: Return link appears only on active loans
Client completes a loan flow using only links
Hypermedia use justified for the project

days.topic: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect Design for APIs
days.lab_task: Design scopes for the orders API, configure an identity provider for a web app, a mobile app and a partner service with the right flows, and validate audiences in the API.
checks: Mobile client signs in with authorization code and PKCE
Partner service gets a token without a user

days.topic: API Security: OWASP API Security Top 10
days.lab_task: Find and fix planted issues in a sample API: object-level access gaps, mass assignment, unlimited page sizes and an admin endpoint open to users, then retest with ZAP.
days.deliverable: Security findings, fixes and retest report
checks: Users cannot read other users' orders
objectives: Fix them in design and code

days.topic: Designing Webhooks: Delivery, Signatures and Retries
days.lab_task: Design and build outgoing webhooks for order events with subscriptions, signatures, retries with backoff and a replay feature, and write the consumer guide.

days.topic: Search and Complex Filtering APIs
subtopics: Simple filters compared with query languages
Filter syntaxes such as RQL and OData-style filters
tools: Search engine or database full-text search
days.lab_task: Design a search endpoint for the catalogue with a safe filter syntax, full-text search, facets and limits, and protect it against expensive queries.

days.topic: Evolving APIs Without Breaking Clients
subtopics: The robustness principle and its limits
days.lab_task: Replace a field with a better one through expand and contract, track which clients still use the old field, publish a migration guide and remove it when usage is zero.
checks: Usage of the old field reported per client
Field removed only after zero usage

days.topic: Contract Testing and Schema Validation in CI
days.lab_task: Validate responses against the description with a proxy, fuzz with Schemathesis, add Pact contracts for two consumers and gate deployments on all three.
checks: Proxy flags a response that breaks the schema

days.topic: SDK Generation and Client Experience
days.lab_task: Generate TypeScript and Python SDKs from the description, add pagination helpers and retries, publish them to private registries and test them against the API.
checks: Both SDKs build and call the API
SDK iterates all pages with one call

days.topic: AsyncAPI for Event-Driven Interfaces
subtopics: When APIs are events, not requests
days.lab_task: Describe the order events in AsyncAPI with Kafka bindings and message schemas, generate documentation, lint it and link it to the OpenAPI description.
checks: Every event channel and message described

days.topic: API Gateways and Management Platforms
subtopics: Routing, authentication and limits at the gateway
tools: Kong, Azure API Management, AWS API Gateway or Apigee
days.lab_task: Publish the orders API through a gateway with token checks, rate limits, a product with two plans and a developer portal, and manage policies as code.
checks: Developer gets a key for a plan
Requests beyond the plan limit rejected
Policy change applied from a repository

days.topic: Observability for APIs: Logs, Metrics and Traces per Endpoint
subtopics: What to measure for each endpoint
Metrics: rate, errors and duration per route
days.lab_task: Instrument the API with per-route metrics, traces and client identification, define SLOs for two endpoints and build dashboards with alerts.
checks: Latency and errors shown per route and client
Trace spans the API and its dependencies
Alert fires when an SLO is at risk

days.topic: Performance: Payload Size, Compression and N+1 Calls
subtopics: N+1 calls between client and API
days.lab_task: Measure a slow screen that makes many API calls, add expansion and field selection, enable compression, fix server N+1 queries and record before and after numbers.
checks: Screen loads with fewer API calls
Payload size smaller with field selection and compression

days.topic: Internationalisation, Time Zones and Money in APIs
days.lab_task: Add language negotiation for error messages, store and return times correctly across time zones, represent money with currency codes and test with users from three countries.
checks: Errors returned in the requested language
Appointment times correct across three time zones
Amounts carry currency codes and round correctly

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Public Partner API with Developer Portal
days.lab_task: Design and launch a partner API with an API-first process, style rules, async operations, webhooks, OAuth 2.0, contract tests, SDKs, a gateway with plans and a developer portal, then present it.
days.deliverable: API descriptions, implementation, portal and presentation
checks: Partner signs up and makes a first call from the portal
Security, contract and performance reports meet targets
Design choices explained against partner needs
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one API product

advanced.summary: For API architects, platform owners and technical leads. Covers API strategy and products, governance programmes, platform APIs, multi-tenant design, choosing between REST, GraphQL, gRPC and events, security architecture, rate limiting and monetisation, large versioning programmes, reliability, global APIs and data residency, APIs for AI agents, open banking and FAPI, API analytics, developer experience, modernising SOAP and RPC, testing at scale, streaming APIs, lifecycle automation and incident troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Several years designing and running production APIs
Strong OpenAPI, security and gateway experience
Has led API work across teams
outcomes: Set API strategy and governance for an organisation
Architect secure, reliable and global API platforms
Choose API styles and lead modernisation programmes
Run APIs as products with metrics and developer experience

days.topic: API Strategy and API Products
subtopics: Internal, partner and public API strategies
Roadmaps and lifecycle for API products
days.lab_task: Build an API product strategy for a logistics company with three API products, target consumers, business models, roadmaps and success measures, and present it to mock executives.
checks: Each product has consumers, value and model

days.topic: API Governance Programmes for Large Organisations
days.lab_task: Design a governance programme for 300 APIs with a federated model, automated checks, a light review process, an API catalogue and governance metrics.
checks: Every API listed with owner and lifecycle state

days.topic: Designing Platform APIs for Many Teams
subtopics: Long-running operations as a platform standard
Errors and quotas across the platform
Learning from public cloud API guidelines
days.lab_task: Design a set of internal platform APIs for compute, storage and deployments following one set of guidelines, with standard methods, operations and errors, and review them against public cloud guidance.
days.deliverable: Platform API designs and guideline map
checks: All resources follow the same method patterns
Long-running work uses one operation model

days.topic: Multi-Tenant API Design
subtopics: Tenancy in URIs, tokens and headers
days.lab_task: Design tenancy for a SaaS API with tenant identity from tokens, isolation rules, per-tenant quotas, admin cross-tenant operations and residency, and prove isolation with tests.
checks: No cross-tenant data through any endpoint
Per-tenant quota enforced without affecting others

days.topic: Choosing Between REST, GraphQL, gRPC and Events
subtopics: Strengths and limits of each style
days.lab_task: For five integration scenarios, prototype the two strongest styles, compare them on clear criteria and record decisions with reasons.
checks: Criteria scores recorded for each prototype
Each decision has context, options and consequences

days.topic: API Security Architecture: Zero Trust, mTLS and Fine-Grained Authorisation
days.lab_task: Threat model an API platform, require mTLS for partners, add fine-grained authorisation through a policy engine and design key rotation and security monitoring.
checks: Partner calls without a certificate refused
Policy engine denies a disallowed action
Keys rotated with no failed requests

days.topic: Advanced Rate Limiting, Quotas and Monetisation
days.lab_task: Implement distributed per-plan quotas with burst handling, meter usage for billing, connect metering to invoices and detect abusive patterns.
checks: Plan quotas enforced across gateway nodes

days.topic: Large-Scale API Versioning and Deprecation Programmes
days.lab_task: Plan the retirement of a widely used API version with usage tracking, communications, migration tooling, staged brownouts and final sunset, and simulate the timeline.
checks: Final sunset completed with no unplanned impact

days.topic: API Reliability: SLOs, Error Budgets and Graceful Degradation
days.lab_task: Define SLOs for a partner API, simulate dependency failures, return degraded responses, shed load by priority and run a consumer-facing incident communication.
checks: SLOs agreed for the main operations
API returns degraded data when a dependency fails
Status page updates sent during the drill

days.topic: Global APIs: Latency, Data Residency and Edge Delivery
days.lab_task: Design a global API for users in India, Europe and the US with regional data residency, edge caching, global routing and cost estimates.
days.deliverable: Global API design with cost model
checks: Personal data stays in the user's region
Edge caching lowers latency for public data

days.topic: Designing APIs for AI Agents and LLM Tool Use
subtopics: Model Context Protocol servers over APIs
Scopes and limits for agent clients
Evaluating agent success with an API
days.lab_task: Expose a curated subset of the orders API to an agent through an MCP server, add confirmation for risky actions and agent-specific scopes, and evaluate task success.
checks: Agent completes most test tasks through the API
Cancellation requires an explicit confirmation step
Agent cannot call operations outside its scopes

days.topic: Open Banking and Regulated API Standards
subtopics: Open banking and open finance models
Account Aggregator style frameworks in India
days.lab_task: Design a consent-based account information API following FAPI practices with strong authentication, consent records and audit trails, and run conformance checks.
days.deliverable: Regulated API design and conformance results
checks: Every data access tied to a valid consent

days.topic: API Analytics and Product Metrics
days.lab_task: Build an API product dashboard with adoption funnel, time to first call, usage by endpoint and version, error experience and retention, and present insights.
checks: Median time to first call reported
Funnel from sign-up to production use shown
Three product decisions proposed from data

days.topic: Developer Experience Programmes
subtopics: What developer experience means for APIs
days.lab_task: Audit the onboarding journey of an API, fix the top friction points with docs, a sandbox and samples, measure satisfaction before and after and plan the programme.
days.deliverable: Developer experience audit and improvement plan
checks: Top five friction points identified with evidence

days.topic: Modernising Legacy SOAP and RPC Interfaces into REST
subtopics: Running legacy and new interfaces together
days.lab_task: Design a REST facade over a SOAP order service, map operations to resources, migrate one consumer and plan the retirement of the SOAP interface.
checks: Each SOAP operation mapped or retired

days.topic: API Testing Strategy at Scale: Fuzzing, Contracts and Load
days.lab_task: Design a test strategy for an API platform, run fuzzing, contract, load and security tests in pipelines and define quality metrics for releases.
checks: Fuzzing runs on every API in the pipeline
No degradation over a two-hour soak

days.topic: Event-Driven and Streaming APIs at Scale
subtopics: Server-sent events and WebSockets for APIs
days.lab_task: Design an external event API offering webhooks and a streaming option with replay, schema evolution rules and security, and document it with AsyncAPI.
checks: Consumer replays events from a chosen point
Compatible change does not break consumers

days.topic: API Lifecycle Automation and Platform Tooling
subtopics: Lifecycle stages from design to retirement
Publishing to gateways and portals automatically
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that scaffolds a new API, runs lint and contract checks, publishes to the gateway and portal and updates the catalogue and scorecard automatically.
checks: New API created from a template
API appears in the gateway and portal after merge
Scorecard reflects lint and test results

days.topic: Troubleshooting API Incidents
days.lab_task: Work through four incidents: a breaking change, an expired signing key, a runaway client and a dependency outage, restore service, communicate with consumers and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes, communications and a post-incident review
checks: All four incidents mitigated within their time limits
Consumer updates sent at each stage
Review lists causes and follow-up actions

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise API Platform and Governance Programme
days.lab_task: Design an enterprise API platform with product strategy, governance, security architecture, global delivery, monetisation, lifecycle automation and analytics, then defend it to an executive and architecture panel.
days.deliverable: Strategy, platform design, governance pack and defence
checks: Executive questions on value and cost answered
Automated checks block a non-compliant API
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one programme
